name: Netsmart myAvatar
short_description: Enterprise behavioral health EHR from the industry leader, serving CMHCs, CCBHCs, and FQHCs with 20+ integrated modules.
long_description: Netsmart myAvatar is an enterprise-grade behavioral health EHR platform from Netsmart Technologies, the largest information technology provider in the behavioral healthcare sector. Headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, Netsmart has origins tracing back to 1968 and has been acknowledged by KLAS Research as a leading vendor in behavioral health EHR for 14 consecutive years. myAvatar is designed for community-based, residential, and inpatient behavioral health programs, serving CMHCs (Community Mental Health Centers), FQHCs (Federally Qualified Health Centers), and CCBHCs. The platform includes more than 20 modules encompassing patient records, scheduling, progress notes, treatment plans, order entry, pharmacy management, billing, financial reporting, workflow automation, e-prescribing, and document management. myAvatar offers enterprise-grade care coordination, interoperability, and deep clinical, billing, and reporting capabilities for the most demanding behavioral health environments.
one_liner: The #1 behavioral health EHR trusted by the largest community mental health organizations.
best_for: Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) with behavioral health
not_for: Solo practitioners or small private practices
Organizations without dedicated IT implementation resources
Practices seeking simple, affordable EHR solutions
Small group practices with limited budgets

pricing.notes: Subscription-based pricing customized for mid-market and enterprise organizations. Starting price approximately $500/month. Rated 8/10 on cost scale (higher than average). More expensive than competitors like NextGen. Implementation, training, and customization are additional. Contact Netsmart for enterprise pricing.

faqs.q: How much does Netsmart myAvatar cost?
faqs.a: myAvatar uses subscription-based pricing customized for enterprise organizations, starting around $500/month. It's rated higher cost than competitors. Implementation, training, and customization are additional. Contact Netsmart for a personalized quote.

faqs.q: Is Netsmart myAvatar good for small practices?
faqs.a: No, myAvatar is designed for mid-market to enterprise organizations including CMHCs, CCBHCs, and FQHCs. Small practices should consider solutions like SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, or TheraNest.

myAvatar includes 20+ modules: patient records, scheduling, progress notes, treatment plans, order entry, pharmacy management, billing, financial reporting, workflow automation, e-prescribing, document management, and more.

faqs.q: How does Netsmart compare to Qualifacts?
faqs.a: Both serve enterprise behavioral health. Netsmart (myAvatar) has been the market leader for 14+ years per KLAS rankings. Qualifacts (CareLogic, Credible) is a strong competitor. Both are designed for large organizations with complex needs.
